execution.signal: Exactly original merged PR459 six completed bars, one-tick breach/reclaim, frozen Stop, 30min directional dedup, exact future Open after completed+T10/T15, risk>=4 ticks, same session, B-35 entry slack; no new entry filter. Preserve preflight identity and source.
execution.admission: One live modeled position or unresolved entry per symbol. EXIT-before-ENTRY at identical timestamp, block entries while busy. Conditional model fills not claimed as real FINAM fills. Preflight within_known_range is diagnostic, not filtering.
execution.stop: One dated tick beyond completed test-bar rejection extreme, unchanged and resident. Entry-bar Stop eligible, STOP_FIRST if TP and Stop touch same later bar. Adverse Stop gap executes at worse Open.
execution.take: Gross price target distance 3*s+8*t at actual admissible entry Open for full-net 3:1 C1 target; grid-round outward; no retarget or optimizer. TP forbidden on entry M5 candle; on later candles require >=1 tick penetration beyond TP before claiming conditional fill. Simple touch is not a guaranteed fill.
execution.failed_reclaim: Completed subsequent M5 closes >=1 tick adversely outside previously reclaimed known high/low => market exit request once it is causally available at bar.start+5+delay; scheduled exit strictly future M5 Open, never fill at signal Close; resident Stop still active.
execution.time: Maximum hold 120 minutes; place timeout close request no earlier than entry+115 min and model strictly later M5 Open. Request compulsory session flat at B-(15+delay) minutes, schedule first strictly later Open, require modeled acknowledgement by B-10; fail closed when absent.
execution.unknown_entry: Missing/zero-volume scheduled entry M5 target is UNKNOWN_POSSIBLE_FILL; prevent any new entries on the same instrument through end 2023 without independent reconciliation, never assume no execution or cancel confirmation.
execution.unknown_exposure: Any missing/zero-volume expected M5 after entry before model flat sets gross/net/PF to UNKNOWN; request emergency close at first later proven M5 Open, but missing outcome never becomes known. If unable to model flat by B-10 or after 2023 end, exposure unresolved and later entries barred.
execution.costs: C1 exactly one historically dated tick per executed entry and exit. C2 replaces C1 on EXACT SAME FILLS and exit path with two ticks per side, not added to C1, no extra simulated broker/exchange fees/spread/slippage. No margin or real equity return claims.
execution.metrics: All 12 calendar months for every symbol/delay/direction and C1/C2; month NO_COVERAGE/UNKNOWN/zero-trade distinguished; realized trades, exit reason, duration, net R normalized per symbol, PF, expectancy, drawdown, concentration, C2/T15 sensitivity. Annual Net/PF/DD=null where any UNKNOWN exposure invalidates complete results; closed-only diagnostic separate, never assert annual PASS.
execution.tests: Independent signal/exits audit, replay deterministic, full available 2023 only via unbuffered exact-prefix reader, no 2024/25 bytes, historical CNY tick, stop-first, entry-bar no TP, TP penetration, adverse gaps, unknown entry and exposed gaps, frozen old configs and protected non-IntradayLab trees.
execution.scope: Only this first Stage2 new candidate; no Stage3/WF/OOS/LIVE, no old strategy changes and never TradingSystemLab/robot modifications.
